name: Dock Holiday

evidence.note: News story on a 2025 outdoor show: fans danced on the grass and one song set off a full dance party.
Band press kit says its mix of styles keeps crowds dancing.
Band calendar lists Oct 3, 4 PM at the Town of North Hempstead Fall Festival.

dancing.notes: A party cover band. A local paper reported fans dancing on the lawn and a full dance party during 'Uptown Funk' at a library concert.

description: A six-piece Long Island cover band with a female lead singer and sax that mixes funk, country, pop, rock and soul hits.
genres: funk, country, pop, rock and soul covers
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List says North Hempstead Beach Park; the band calls it the Town of North Hempstead Fall Festival.
